traceability.criterion: The chore brief links to `BANDIT-GAP-SPEC-TO-EVIDENCE-TRACEABILITY-MATRIX` as the active bootstrap gap once it becomes the next queued work item.
traceability.evidence_summary: Cockpit and session-context output identify BANDIT-077 as the active work item for the active spec-to-evidence bootstrap gap.

traceability.criterion: A policy or template defines traceability entry schema, supported evidence types, disposition values, required fields, and covered risk tiers.
traceability.evidence_summary: Focused tests require the policy and template to define schema fields, supported evidence types, dispositions, required fields, and covered risk tiers.

traceability.criterion: Covered work items cannot land when acceptance criteria lack concrete verification mapping or explicit disposition.
traceability.evidence_summary: Focused tests prove missing acceptance-criterion mappings fail closed with explicit diagnostics before validation can pass.

traceability.criterion: Review evidence asks whether mapped tests and artifacts prove the stated behavior rather than only existing.
traceability.evidence_summary: Review evidence template fields and focused tests require traceability state, quality, and disposition inspection instead of artifact-presence checks only.

traceability.criterion: Traceability output distinguishes behavior evidence, implementation-detail evidence, UAT evidence, reviewer evidence, replay evidence, and explicit no-action/bootstrap dispositions.
traceability.evidence_summary: Focused tests exercise behavior evidence, command evidence, unsupported evidence, implementation-detail rationale, and explicit disposition handling.

traceability.criterion: `BANDIT-GAP-SPEC-TO-EVIDENCE-TRACEABILITY-MATRIX` is resolved only after landing action and retrospective closeout evidence exist.
traceability.rationale: Final gap resolution is intentionally a Stage 6 closeout check; before landing and retrospective evidence exist, the active ledger state must remain unresolved and this criterion cannot be marked complete.
